To recommend file #30983 to the Kearns Metro Township Council for approval as presented. Motion by: Commissioner Walton 2nd by: Commissioner Hatch Kearns Metro Township Planning Commission – July 22, 2019 – Meeting Summary Vote: Commissioners voted unanimous in favor 30835 – Parkwood Estates Subdivision – Update and final plan approval of a 39 lot subdivision. Location: 5928 South Parkwood Drive. Planner: Curtis Woodward Salt Lake County Planning and Development Services Zoning Administrator provided an analysis of the staff report and plan approval. PUBLIC PORTION OF MEETING OPENED Speaker # 1: Kearns Community Council Name: Roger Snow Address: 5977 South Parkwood Drive Comments: Mr. Snow asked about lot 30 and where is the driveway going to access and how wide is the access to Beehive. Commissioner Nelson asked how many lots were added. Mr. Woodward said additional seven lots. PUBLIC PORTION OF MEETING CLOSED Motion: To approve file #30835 as presented.
